about.heroDescription: SCOPAMI was born with a clear goal: to create a safe, respectful, and exciting space where authentic connections come to life, putting control in the right hands.
about.philosophyText1: We believe that online dating should be a pleasant and safe experience for everyone. That's why we flipped the traditional rules: on SCOPAMI, women make the first move or decide who can contact them.
about.philosophyText2: This approach not only reduces unwanted messages but ensures that every interaction starts with genuine mutual interest, elevating the quality of meetings.
about.valuesSubtitle: What guides every decision and feature we make
about.value1Desc: We implement rigorous identity checks and advanced moderation systems to ensure every user is real and trustworthy.
about.value2Desc: We promote a culture of respect. Our feedback and rating system incentivizes positive and courteous behavior.
about.value3Desc: No hidden costs, clear rules, and a simple token system. We want you to always know what to expect.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to be part of the revolution?
about.ctaDescription: Join SCOPAMI today and discover a new way to experience online dating.

features.title: Unique Features
features.feature1Desc: At SCOPAMI, we flip traditional dating rules. Women have total control: they decide who to contact and who to respond to. This creates a safer and more respectful environment, eliminating unwanted messages.
features.feature2Desc: Our innovative token system ensures quality interactions. Men use tokens to respond to requests or to highlight their profile, demonstrating genuine interest and commitment.
features.feature3Desc: Security is fundamental. We offer a rigorous verification process that includes document checks and real-time selfies. Verified profiles get a special badge, ensuring authenticity and trust.
features.feature4Desc: Transparency is at the heart of our community. After every confirmed meeting, users can leave a review. This system rewards proper behavior and helps everyone make more informed choices.
features.feature5Desc: Your data is sacred. We use advanced encryption to protect your personal information and conversations. You have complete control over what you share and with whom.
features.feature6Desc: We don't aim for quantity, but quality. Our community is made up of people seeking real connections. We constantly monitor activity to remove fake profiles or improper behavior.
features.feature7Desc: Our chat is designed to facilitate conversation. With features like response suggestions and the ability to send media securely, getting to know someone has never been easier.
features.feature8Desc: You're never alone. Our support team is always available to answer your questions, solve technical problems, or handle reports. Your positive experience is our priority.
features.ctaDescription: Join SCOPAMI today and discover a new way to experience online dating.

pricing.title: Plans and Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the solution that best fits your needs. Whether you're looking for your soulmate or offering professional services, we have the right plan for you.
pricing.tokenDescription: Buy tokens to respond to requests and highlight your profile. Tokens are deducted when you decline a request.
pricing.premiumNoteText: Premium Profile is completely optional. Basic app usage is free for all women. This subscription is specifically designed for users who want to offer professional services or maximize their visibility on the platform.
pricing.premiumDescription: Unlock professional tools to best manage your presence.
pricing.pricesIncludeVat: All prices include VAT. Payments are secure and encrypted.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.a1: SCOPAMI is an innovative dating app where women are in control. Women can browse profiles and send requests, while men can respond. This ensures a more respectful and safe environment for everyone.
faq.q2: What are tokens and how do they work?
faq.a2: Tokens are SCOPAMI's virtual currency. They are used to unlock premium features, such as sending meeting requests or highlighting your profile. You can purchase token packages directly from the app.
faq.a3: Yes, registration and profile creation are completely free. Many basic features are accessible to everyone. Some advanced features may require the use of tokens or a Premium subscription.
faq.a4: Security is our priority. To get the 'Verified Profile' badge, you need to submit a photo of your ID and a real-time selfie. Our team will verify the match to ensure you are who you say you are.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use advanced encryption technologies to protect your personal data. We will never share your information with third parties without your explicit consent. Read our Privacy Policy for more details.
faq.a6: After a confirmed meeting through the app, both users can leave a review. This helps maintain high community quality and rewards correct and respectful users. Only real meetings can be reviewed.
faq.a7: Certainly. You can delete your account at any time from your profile settings. Please note that this action is irreversible and all your data, including unused tokens, will be lost.
